profile.summary: Datadog is a Nasdaq-listed (DDOG) cloud observability, monitoring and security software company founded in 2010, with 8,100+ employees and a platform of 24 products on a common data model. Its Q3 2026 revenue rose about 35% year over year to $1.20 billion, and it guided to $4.515 billion to $4.525 billion for full-year 2026.
